item.title: Nexus — When Every Field Lies, Trust the Scorer
item.description: A custom hash chain, 8 data blocks, a 32-byte initial state — and every labeled field in the binary pointing somewhere wrong. Plus a hash chain that turns out not to exist. Reversing the only field that tells the truth: the official scorer itself.

item.title: AfricaHackon: Rooted or not? — Root Check? Bypassed Without Rooting Anything
item.description: Android APK reversing — XOR key recovered, static analysis only. A vault app gates its debug panel behind a root check, but the flag is computed statically. No rooting, no emulator, no Frida needed.
